report:
Reviewed the complete recorded_reads claim, both ordinary implementation entries (main.rs and review.rs), and all eight ordinary associated tests; the symlink test is Unix-conditional, and there are no TODO/N/A entries. Captured the test file as additional context to inspect Fixture construction, saved-input loading, CLI execution helper and reusable tests. Current implementation replaces the historical digest/submission design with per-anchor summary/input/output and selector fragments, so the historical approval was not reused. main.rs parses no-selector reads as WholeFile and explicit lines/claim/test selectors, calls capture_read and prints its exact returned string. capture_read resolves the Cargo workspace, validates directory identity/version, rejects completed summaries or output files, loads the existing input, selects text, appends path/selector/source lines, persists through atomic rename, and only then returns that same text. source_path rejects absolute/traversal paths and canonical symlink escapes. select rejects invalid ranges and missing/mismatched/ambiguous claim/test identities. Vector push preserves repeated reads and order. input_errors re-resolves every appended fragment and compares exact text; both recording and checking use this validation. PROMPT makes complete dependency declaration the reviewer's responsibility. No implementation defect was identified by this source inspection.

The complete associated test set was evaluated: whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits asserts exact CRLF and final-line selection, invalid range rejection, repeated appended fragments, unselected range tolerance and selected/whole-file staleness. declared_claim_read_tracks_selected_text_without_capturing_the_document checks returned/saved claim equality and unaffected movement versus claim edits. another_anchors_test_read_tracks_body_and_identity rejects recording after an additional selected test body changes, disappears or becomes ambiguous. test_selectors_disambiguate_identical_paths_by_cargo_target tests separate target identity and rejects the wrong crate. invalid_ids_and_paths_are_rejected_without_destroying_existing_reports rejects absent review, traversal/absolute/missing files, mismatched claim path and missing test identity while preserving input. recorded_reads_reject_symlink_escape_without_capturing_context asserts rejection and unchanged saved input. These bodies substantively exercise the library path. The associated start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required now directly asserts completed-review read rejection after a successful recording, and verifies reading preserves the unfinished state. The newly associated cli_read_defaults_to_whole_file_from_workspace_subdirectory invokes the actual binary from src with context.txt present only at the workspace root, omits a selector, checks successful execution, exact CRLF/newline stdout, one appended fragment, unchanged initial prefix, exact saved path/WholeFile selector/content, and a null recording timestamp. These assertions would detect the previously uncovered default-selector, workspace resolution, output modification, missing persistence and completed-review acceptance regressions. Both prior requested edits are therefore resolved by meaningful associated assertions. No outstanding implementation or test adequacy edits remain.

Execution evidence: this reviewer ran fresh cargo meta review start, recorded review read, and cargo fmt --check (passed), and will record this report. No behavior test suite was rerun by this reviewer and no Rust source was edited. The coordinator reports 31 review tests, 331 functional tests and cargo build passing before the latest annotation-only changes; that is separate execution evidence, not substituted for source adequacy assessment. Captured helper source is the complete tests/review.rs file. The latest test-only quality review found no formatting, mutex, meaningful duplication, exhaustiveness, unsafe or comment-hygiene issues; user-facing and architecture documentation checks are inapplicable because these changes only test existing behavior. All three Sage-specific anti-pattern checks also found no issues. The additional source_representation associations attach tests with explicit markup/blank-line and CRLF/source-line reconstruction assertions, and the staleness association attaches an existing test rejecting changed schema/policy/anchor metadata; these annotations are supported by the bodies inspected.
